close_reason:
All 7 Space/set sub-operations now wired through space_update via SpacePatch. Added input structs to methods/mod.rs: SpaceAddRoleInput, SpaceUpdateRoleInput, SpaceUpdateChannelInput, SpaceAddCategoryInput, SpaceUpdateCategoryInput (with builder-style new() + with_color helpers where applicable). Extended SpacePatch with update_channels, add_roles, remove_roles, update_roles, add_categories, remove_categories, update_categories fields, all defaulting to None.

Wire serialization in space.rs follows the existing add_channels / update_members pattern: empty-slice skipping, defence-in-depth empty-name guards for add_roles/add_categories, Patch::map_entry() for Patch<&str>/Patch<&Id> fields (color, topic, category_id). permissionOverrides accepts &[jmap_chat_types::ChannelPermission] which already implements Serialize. updateRoles permissions field is a fresh array, mirroring the create path.

No new inline tests — existing crate convention is no tests in space.rs; comprehensive wire-format coverage is tracked under JMAP-uuoi. cargo fmt/clippy/test --workspace all green.
